synthesis: The ticket's core premise is stale. ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController@recentHits already exists (added DEV-2130, PR #247, at line 494) and is routed at GET scout/org-map/api/dashboard/recent-hits (web.php:135); the same Pinia dashboard store + fetchRecentHits() the driver uses already consumes it via an automatic admin/driver BASE_URL swap. So this is NOT a new-endpoint build. The real work is 4 targeted changes to one surface: (1) un-hide the Live Hits Pending Repossession list in admin mode (remove the !mapStore.adminMode guards in DashboardOverlay.vue lines 38/56 — the expanded panel already carries admin-aware copy at 73-75); (2) correct the existing recentHits() to (a) include Staging Live (currently liveValid() = Direct-only) and (b) reflect CURRENT hotlist status via the FINAL semi-join (currently frozen forStatus(Open)) — both are exactly what the sibling hits() on the same controller already does; (3) swap {{ hit.status }} at DashboardOverlay.vue:89 for a Direct/Staging Live pill reusing MapShell's HIT_TYPE_LABELS ({L:'Direct Live',S:'Staging Live'}, hit_type==='S'? amber : blue); (4) add a ?range param end-to-end (dashboard.js fetchRecentHits(range) + setRange() call site, and recentHits() range filter via getDateRange()). AC #4 (label in the hit detail view) is ALREADY satisfied — MapShell.vue (the shared bottom sheet opened via mapStore.focusHit()) renders the Direct/Staging pill and never renders .status.

questions.q: Does the ticket premise 'BirdsEyeController has NO recentHits endpoint' still hold?
questions.answer: No — recentHits() exists (BirdsEyeController:494) and is routed (web.php:135), added in DEV-2130/PR #247. Work is correcting it, not building it.

questions.q: Should the admin list include Staging Live hits (current liveValid() is Direct-only)?
questions.answer: Yes — ticket asks Direct AND Staging with distinct labels; sibling hits()/stats() already include both via forHitTypes([Live, Staging_Live]).

questions.q: Where is 'Open' rendered in the hit detail view (ticket open-question #2)?
questions.answer: Nowhere — MapShell.vue (shared detail bottom sheet via mapStore.focusHit()) already shows the Direct/Staging pill and never renders .status. AC #4 needs no code change.

questions.q: Q4 (MATERIAL): Should admin recentHits reflect CURRENT hotlist status (FINAL semi-join, matching sibling hits()) rather than the frozen per-hit column it uses today?
questions.answer: Yes — adopt CURRENT status via the FINAL semi-join against clarity.hotlist, exactly like sibling hits(). Already-repossessed vehicles drop off the pending-repo list and it agrees with the map pins; closes the DEV-2117 gap for this surface.

questions.q: Q7: AC-5 'count agrees with stats' — literal equality or moves-together?
questions.answer: Moves-together: list and stats both scope to the same date range and refresh together on filter change; no literal numeric equality (stats counts all valid hits; list is open-only, plate-deduped, capped 20).

questions.q: Q5: 'Org-wide (all drivers)' — override the driver-selector, or is org-wide just the default (no selection) with the kit_ids selector still honored like every other Bird's Eye endpoint?
questions.answer: Org-wide is the default; honor the driver selector exactly like sibling hits()/stats()/scanPaths() (scopedKits() intersects an optional kit_ids against the org's kits). No divergence.

questions.q: Q6: Should the driver recentHits also gain a range param?
questions.answer: No — AC 6 requires the driver view stay unchanged. Range param is admin-only.

notes: Ticket grounding is stale (pre-DEV-2130): the 'new org-scoped endpoint' is already built + routed. Effort profile is much smaller than the ticket implies.
Reuse, don't refactor: HIT_TYPE_LABELS + amber/blue classes are already inlined in MapShell/DayOverlay/TripOverlay; add a 4th inline copy in DashboardOverlay per existing convention.
hit.type vs hit_type: payload/template field is hit_type (ticket says hit.type). Payload already includes it (recentHits:520).

Cache: recentHits() is currently uncached (unlike stats/hits). If adding caching, the range MUST be in the cache key or results leak across range switches. Simplest correct path: mirror stats() cache-key+TTL, or leave uncached — decide during build (not material).
